attributes.check1: Melee or Fortitude or Diplomacy or Divine 20
attributes.name: Rite of Heraldry
attributes.powers:
The Rite of Heraldry may not be evaded; if you have a card in hand that has the Corrupted trait, this barrier is undefeated.

You may recharge a card that has the Iomedae trait to add 1d20 to your check to defeat this barrier.

If undefeated, each character at your location is dealt 1d10 Force damage that may not be reduced.

If defeated, you may put a marker on the location card Heaven.
